mod.name: DTMAPI Auto Fishing
config.status.experimental: {0} toggles the native auto-fishing loop. Current state: {1}.
config.boundary.current: Default loop: cast at the configured charge, wait for a native bite, reel, play the real minigame through native green/red/yellow bar input, collect the result, then recast. Instant bite, cast charge, minigame skipping, and animation speed are independent.
config.toggleKey.name: Toggle key
config.toggleKey.tooltip: Click Capture, then press the next key. Reset restores F6; Escape, Backspace, or Delete clears the binding.
config.castChargeRatio.name: Cast charge
config.castChargeRatio.tooltip: Set native cast charge from 0 (minimum distance) to 1 (full charge). This does not change animation speed.
config.skipMinigame.name: Skip minigame
config.skipMinigame.tooltip: Route bite-ready results through the native no-minigame result path. Native failure/success is preserved.
config.instantBite.name: Instant bite
config.instantBite.tooltip: Skip the native waiting period after the hook reaches water, then reel into the normal minigame/result path.
config.fastAnimations.name: Fast fishing animations
config.fastAnimations.tooltip: Speed up the native backswing/charge animation, charge timing, cast hook flight, and pull phases without changing the charge target. Supports 1-4x.
